Stephen Mark Flynn [ 1 ] (born 13 October 1988) [ 2 ] is a Scottish politician who has served as the Scottish National Party (SNP) Member of Parliament (MP) for Aberdeen South since 2019 , and as the Member of the Scottish Parliament (MSP) for Aberdeen Deeside and North Kincardine since 2026 . He has served as the leader of the SNP in the House of Commons since December 2022. Under his leadership, the party lost 39 seats at the 2024 general election , reducing the SNP to the second-largest party in Westminster from Scotland and the fourth-largest party in Parliament. He was elected to the Scottish Parliament in the 2026 Scottish Parliament election and is expected to resign as an MP. [ 3 ]
